separation_from_host_result.pre_host_candidate_followed: Schoener's D in a common environmental PCA space
separation_from_host_result.v03_family_note: Study B belongs to the new v0.3 prospective family; prior empirical genetic outcomes cannot tune this rule.

occurrence_acquisition.page_selection: if <=6000 indexed rows, retrieve sequential pages; otherwise retrieve 20 deterministic evenly spaced page offsets across [0,min(count,100000)-300]
occurrence_acquisition.exact_coordinate_duplicates: retain the lowest GBIF key at each exact coordinate

environment.missing_environment: drop an occurrence if any of four variables is non-finite/nodata; species must still retain >=30 points

common_environment_space.pca_sampling: first up to 50 retained occurrence points per species in frozen occurrence-priority order
common_environment_space.standardization: pooled PCA-sample mean and population SD for each of four variables
common_environment_space.pca: eigendecomposition of standardized pooled covariance; canonicalize each eigenvector sign so its largest-absolute loading is positive
common_environment_space.whitening: divide PC1 and PC2 scores by sqrt of their pooled eigenvalues

schoener_d.grid: 50 x 50 fixed grid in whitened PC1-PC2 space
schoener_d.grid_bounds: pooled PCA-sample 0.5th to 99.5th percentile on each axis plus 10% range padding
schoener_d.species_density: isotropic Gaussian KDE evaluated at grid-cell centers
schoener_d.bandwidth: Scott factor n_species^(-1/6) in the globally whitened two-dimensional space
schoener_d.normalization: each species KDE grid sums to 1

panel_assignment_after_environment_admis.ranking: SHA256('relational-env-panel-v0.1|<phylogatr_source_sha256>|<species>'), species tie-break, applied only after the frozen freshness exclusion
panel_assignment_after_environment_admis.within_panel_roles: sort each panel by SHA256('relational-env-role-v0.1|<phylogatr_source_sha256>|<species>'); lower floor(n/2) are sources, remainder targets
panel_assignment_after_environment_admis.development_empirical_genetic_response: permanently closed; geometry + environment + synthetic worlds only
panel_assignment_after_environment_admis.confirmatory_empirical_genetic_response: one-shot only after exact geometry/mask/requalification gates

future_pair_controls.geographic_opportunity: directed target-edge coverage within 500 km of source edges, reconstructed from frozen genetic geometry before identity

allowed_outputs_before_genetics: R_env correlation with response-blind geographic opportunity and lineage controls
forbidden: using host Study A beta_R or T_st to select environmental variables, PCA axes, KDE bandwidth, grid, or panel
using Study B nucleotide identity or genetic distance before all gates pass
selecting a favorable subset of orders after Study B response opening
replacing Schoener's D after seeing Study B genetic response
allow any of the frozen 70 prior-design-overlap species into PCA, panel assignment, or Study-B inference
replace excluded species with newly scanned candidates after seeing any Study-B qualification or response result

freshness_before_pca_and_panel.stage: Compute occurrence/environment availability on the inherited fresh-1000 only; then remove the exact frozen 70-species prior-design overlap before pooled PCA, density construction, or panel hashing.
